title: Electricity & Magnetism
summary: Magnets and their invisible fields, complete circuits, conductors and insulators, the heating effect that powers irons and fuses, and electromagnets you can switch on and off.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Electrical and magnetic systems work only when every part plays its role, and understanding them lets us design useful and safe technology.

conceptual: How are electricity and magnetism connected?
Why are homes wired in parallel with fuses or MCBs?
debatable: Should every Indian home be required to have an earth leakage circuit breaker (RCCB)?
Is it worth paying more for energy-efficient appliances?
